public.title: Sort List
public.description: values encodes a singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Return its values in ascending numeric order, retaining duplicates. There are 0 to 1000 integer values from -10000 to 10000. This JSON adaptation checks sorted values; try merge sort as a linked-list extension.
hints: Merge sorted halves using two indices.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Recursive merge sort combines stable sorted halves in O(n log n) time and O(n) auxiliary space for this array encoding.
